purpose: Machine-readable publication registry for the independent natural-data four-gate synthesis. This registry routes locked results; it does not pool effect sizes or change frozen analyses.

systems.candidate_state: TM_z + FDQ + FEve functional partial state
systems.evidence_summary: held-out MSE 1.08774 for partial state versus 1.13209 after mainland distance; 4.08% worsening; distance model improved 3/8 held-out sites
systems.claim_ceiling: No detected transferable mainland-distance gain after the locked partial state; does not establish state completeness or biological irrelevance of distance.

systems.evidence_summary: 0/6 reproductive endpoints met the preregistered positive residual-context rule under the locked garden-holdout design
systems.claim_ceiling: No reproducible positive held-out gain from the locked local/urban context terms after the interaction state; does not imply urban context is biologically irrelevant.

systems.candidate_state: phytometer identity + effort-standardised direct visitation + focal floral units + source-matched garden floral richness
systems.evidence_summary: adding urban cover and green-space edge density increased total held-out NLL by 4932.9195; garden-bootstrap 95% interval [603.9654, 10953.6611]
systems.claim_ceiling: No detected held-out residual urban-context gain after the locked partial state; does not establish complete state measurement or urban irrelevance.

systems.candidate_state: current pollinator-treatment state before spatial mating opportunity
systems.evidence_summary: adding maternal spatial isolation reduced leave-one-maternal-plant-out MSE from 0.11619 to 0.09187, a 20.93% improvement; locked permutation p=0.00130
systems.claim_ceiling: Spatial mating opportunity remained a missing contemporary coordinate for the declared endpoint; not a general isolation law or direct functional-loss result.

systems.candidate_state: preregistered pan-trap count / mean-ITD pollinator proxy state
systems.declared_endpoint: primary seed-function endpoint plus independently estimable mating and pollen-movement endpoints
systems.evidence_summary: exact metadata gate found Fallow ground versus Fallow graound; prospective one-key sensitivity found the same mismatch at a second array and stopped before seed-function model fitting; independently estimable endpoints did not show reproducible held-out proxy gain
systems.claim_ceiling: The candidate proxy did not earn general endpoint-relevant state status under the frozen design; pollinator irrelevance and endpoint/proxy rescue are not authorised.

systems.evidence_summary: leave-one-orchard-out NB2 analysis across 20 orchards; fruit-production gains -0.10195 [-3.12202, 3.61919] and -0.09919 [-3.14415, 3.66453]; residual-context gate not opened
systems.claim_ceiling: Neither deposited pollinator-abundance representation earned endpoint-relevant adequacy; does not imply pollinator irrelevance.

systems.candidate_state: phase-visitation versus independently calibrated effective-transfer interaction coordinates
systems.evidence_summary: 23-population leave-one-population-out test; no fixed interaction representation beat the mean baseline; after feature-wise standardisation effective-transfer coordinates were constant positive rescalings of phase-visitation coordinates and differed by at most 8.88e-16
systems.claim_ceiling: The declared representation erased the efficiency multiplier that made the richer biological measurement distinct; no alternative scaling or endpoint rerun is authorised.

cross_study.reason: origin is confounded with study, taxa, protocol, biological coordinate, and response construction; the subsequent four-archive bridge stopped at automated archive access before schema mapping or outcome modelling
cross_study.claim_ceiling: STOP is a design boundary, not evidence for or against a shared urban-island or origin-level ecological law.
